version 0.1.0

source "probe"
key x int -

pack:
format probe
version 0.20.0
distribution public
source "probe"
uses probe
wire bits
layout sequential
field probe.x 8 uint
presence p 2
switch probe.x
  case 1,2
    if p.1
      field probe.y 8 uint
    end
  case 3
  case 4
    switch probe.x
      case 4
        field probe.z 8 uint
    end
  else
    field probe.y 4 uint
end
field probe.z 8 uint
